FLYING SNIPER: Shortly after the start was crowded by SHINYU KOKOROE which shifted out.
JOLLY COMPANION: Approaching the 300 Metres made contact with GIMME FIVE due to both runners shifting ground.  Z Purton stated that after obtaining a position outside the lead his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight but could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer K L Man advised that the horse had pleased him leading into the race and he had instructed Jockey Purton to go forward from its wide barrier.  He added the only explanation he could offer for the horse’s disappointing performance was that too much use had to be made of the horse in the early stages to go forward.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of JOLLY COMPANION was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, JOLLY COMPANION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DAILY TROPHY: Bumped on jumping. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  L Ferraris stated that the preference was to hold a more forward position, but despite riding his mount along in the early stages it failed to show sufficient pace to do so.
MAGIC SUPER: Jumped only fairly.  The performance of MAGIC SUPER, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MAGIC SUPER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WAVE GARDEN: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 700 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid FLYING SNIPER.  Near the 200 Metres was steadied and directed to the inside of THOUSAND CUPS to secure clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SHINYU KOKOROE: Lay out in the Home Straight, resulting in its rider K Teetan changing his whip through to his left hand near the 100 Metres.  Noted to have lost its right front plate after the race.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HAPPY ACTION: Near the 50 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of THOUSAND CUPS to continue into clear running.  A Atzeni stated that the preference was to hold a more forward position but despite riding his mount along in the early stages it failed to show sufficient pace to do so.
GIMME FIVE: On jumping shifted in and made contact with DAILY TROPHY. Approaching the 300 Metres made contact with JOLLY COMPANION due to both runners shifting ground.  Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that after leading the event her mount failed to run on in the Home Straight and was disappointing.  Trainer Y S Tsui advised that the horse had pleased him leading into the race and he was of the opinion that Apprentice Yuen had to make too much use of the horse in the early stages to lead and this was the principal reason for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GIMME FIVE was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, GIMME FIVE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

MAJESTIC LIFE: Jumped only fairly.  Leaving the 100 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of SOLAR RIVER to continue into clear running.
TOPSPIN KING: Jumped only fairly.  M L Yeung was warned in respect to using his whip on a horse which was not responding to his riding on one occasion near the 100 Metres.
VERBIER: Near the 250 Metres was bumped by VON BAER.
DIRIYA: B Avdulla reported that the instructions were to obtain a position with cover.  He said when his mount commenced well it showed superior pace and led without being pressured to do so.  He added DIRIYA failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and raced disappointingly.  Trainer C H Yip advised that he had not expected the horse to lead and, in his opinion, DIRIYA travelled too strongly in front which resulted in it being left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CONCORDE STAR: Bumped on jumping.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind SPICY SPANGLE. <12/10/2026 Additional Veterinary Reports>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that CONCORDE STAR was found to be displaying an irregular heart rhythm on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, CONCORDE STAR will be subjected to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SOLAR RIVER: For some distance approaching the 300 Metres was held up behind DIRIYA.
DASH: When questioned regarding her mount settling further back in the field than its previous race start Apprentice P N Wong stated that her instructions were to ensure DASH began well but she was asked to obtain a position with cover.  She said for this reason in the early stages she allowed VON BAER to shift out and cross DASH to comply with her instructions.  Trainer D J Whyte confirmed the instructions and expressed satisfaction with the manner in which the horse was ridden today.

Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that the intention was to be more forward but after making contact with SPICY SPANGLE at the start her mount settled further back than intended.  She added that over the concluding stages she was unable to ride her mount out when held up behind DASH.
VON BAER: Lay out when placed under pressure over the final 400 Metres and near the 250 Metres shifted out and made contact with VERBIER.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ISLAND BREEZES: On jumping was crowded by DIRIYA which shifted in.  A Atzeni stated that his mount did not travel well during the early stages of the race.  He added over the final 100 Metres he was unable to ride ISLAND BREEZES out when held up behind CONCORDE STAR.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CROSSBORDERDUDE: A Atzeni advised that CROSSBORDERDUDE would derive benefit from today’s first up performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CALL ME SPARKLE: For a short distance making the Home Turn was held up behind INVINCIBLE STARR.  J Orman stated that the instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said after his mount jumped only fairly and then was crowded by LUCKY DOCTOR which shifted out shortly after the start, he was then unable to hold his position to the inside of INVINCIBLE STARR in the early stages and as a result settled slightly further back than intended.  Sent for sampling post-race.
INVINCIBLE STARR: After travelling a short distance was steadied to avoid LUCKY DOCTOR which lay out.

Near the 600 Metres became badly unbalanced when bumped heavily by LUCKY DOCTOR which shifted out abruptly.  B Avdulla reported that after being bumped heavily near the 600 Metres his mount lost momentum from that point and failed to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  HOLMES A COURT, which weakened in the Home Straight, will be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
WARRIORS DREAM: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start became unbalanced when it got its head up whilst being restrained to obtain a position with cover.  Near the 700 Metres was steadied to avoid BEST FARM which was taken in by MIGHTY PROFIT (C L Chau) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  C L Chau was advised to exercise more care.
SUPER DRAGON: Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
BEST FARM: Near the 700 Metres was steadied to avoid MIGHTY PROFIT.  From the 350 Metres to the 300 Metres was held up for clear running when being shifted to the outside of MIGHTY PROFIT.
FOREVER LIFE: Withdrawn on 10.10.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter HOLMES A COURT.  Before being allowed to race again, FOREVER LIFE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SKY CAP: Was examined at the Start by the Veterinary Officer and found to be suitable to race. On jumping shifted out and bumped KEMPES.
CALA DEI MORI: When questioned regarding his riding of CALA DEI MORI and the reason he rode his mount forward to race outside BUSTLING CITY, E C W Wong confirmed that his instructions were to go forward and take up a position behind the expected leaders BUSTLING CITY and LUCY IN THE SKY.  He said as his mount does have a tendency to jump fairly he ensured that CALA DEI MORI jumped well and then rode his mount along in the early stages to comply with his instructions.  He said after riding his mount along and when caught wide to the outside of LUCY IN THE SKY, CALA DEI MORI, which was racing in blinkers for the first time, then commenced to race keenly and as a result he improved forward of LUCY IN THE SKY to race outside BUSTLING CITY.  He added in the early stages CALA DEI MORI would not settle and as a result the pace of the event was run faster than he would have preferred, however, his mount would not respond to his efforts to set a more sustainable pace.  He said from the 800 Metres CALA DEI MORI settled better and he was able to restrain the horse to obtain a position further back from BUSTLING CITY.  Trainer C S Shum confirmed the instructions were to obtain a position with cover behind the expected leaders and agreed that CALA DEI MORI raced keenly with blinkers being applied for the first time.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Wong that he had made an error of judgement in the early stages by riding his mount along which resulted in CALA DEI MORI racing too keenly, particularly as he was aware that the horse had raced keenly in its two barrier trials on 19 September 2026 and 2 October 2026 when it wore blinkers on those occasions.  Jockey Wong was further advised that in similar circumstances he would be expected to show better judgement than what he did on this occasion so as to leave no room for query.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KEMPES: Bumped on jumping. From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ZHUANG YUAN GLORY: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that the horse did not appreciate the kickback in the early stages on the All Weather surface.
DRAGON JOY: Blundered on jumping. The performance of DRAGON JOY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON JOY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MIGHTY COMMANDER: Withdrawn on 9.10.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (fractious whilst being transported from Conghua to Hong Kong).  Before being allowed to race again, MIGHTY COMMANDER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MUST GO: Withdrawn on raceday morning by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (skin condition).  Before being allowed to race again, MUST GO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
JUICY DRAGON: On jumping made contact with KING’S ARROW and became unbalanced.
MEGA CAPTAIN: Z Purton pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 100 Metres (see CENTRAL BANK).  Sent for sampling post-race.
CENTRAL BANK: Near the 800 Metres CENTRAL BANK shifted to the outside of NOBLE DELUXE to obtain a three wide position as MEGA CAPTAIN (Z Purton) improved to the outside of CENTRAL BANK.  Making the turn near the 700 Metres CENTRAL BANK was then eased when crowded between NOBLE DELUXE which shifted out slightly and MEGA CAPTAIN which shifted in slightly as it established a three wide position behind JUICY DRAGON. Held up for clear running between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres. Z Purton was advised in similar circumstances he should exercise more care to ensure runners to his inside are provided with sufficient racing room.  Z Purton (MEGA CAPTAIN) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 100 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when not clear of CENTRAL BANK, resulting in CENTRAL BANK having to be checked.  Z Purton was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record.

GROUPER: E C W Wong stated that his mount jumped awkwardly and as a result lost ground at the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GIANT SPIRIT: Shifted out on jumping and made contact with KING’S ARROW.
KING'S ARROW: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was checked when crowded by GIANT SPIRIT which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.  Approaching the 100 Metres, when laying in, was bumped by CENTRAL BANK which was taken out by MEGA CAPTAIN.
NOBLE DELUXE: A Atzeni stated that his mount gave ground noticeably in the Home Straight and raced in a disappointing manner but could offer no explanation for the performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
STANLEY EXPRESS: Shortly after the start was eased when crowded between PARROT BLESSING and ENJOY GOLF, both of which shifted ground.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
GALLANT DESIGN: Z Purton stated that his mount jumped awkwardly and as a result settled slightly further back in the field than he had anticipated.  Sent for sampling post-race.

GLORY PATCH: Jumped only fairly.  Lay in in the Home Straight and raced greenly.
TELECOM FORTUNE: In the early stages raced keenly and near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid LET’S HAVE FUN.  Again near the 850 Metres was steadied to avoid LET’S HAVE FUN.
PARROT BLESSING: Shifted in at the start and made contact with LET’S HAVE FUN.  Bumped near the 200 Metres.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
ENJOY GOLF: Jumped awkwardly.  H Bentley stated that the intention was to cross and lead but when NOBLE SUPERIOR held its position to his inside  he was obliged to race outside that runner.  He added under pressure in the Home Straight ENJOY GOLF disappointed in the manner in which it responded. LET'S HAVE FUN: Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.

ABSOLUTE AWAKENED: Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded by ONE MORE.
ONE MORE: On jumping bumped with STUNNING BUNDLE due to both runners shifting ground.  ONE MORE then shifted in and away from STUNNING BUNDLE and crowded ABSOLUTE AWAKENED.  Near the 550 Metres endeavoured to improve into a run between STORM MIRROR and SOO KOO when there was not sufficient room to do so.  When SOO KOO held its position, ONE MORE then was checked when disappointed between STORM MIRROR and SOO KOO.  H T Mo was reprimanded and advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to ride with more care than he did on this occasion.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, ONE MORE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
STORM MIRROR: C Y Ho advised that he was instructed to take up a forward position but not necessarily lead.  He said whilst STORM MIRROR jumped only fairly it then showed good early pace to lead the event.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions and stated those instructions were the same issued at its most recent start when it settled further back than he had anticipated.  Sent for sampling post-race.

He said making the Home Turn STUNNING BUNDLE shifted out and he improved to its inside.  He said as he improved to the inside of STUNNING BUNDLE, ONE MORE endeavoured to obtain running between STORM MIRROR and SOO KOO where there was not sufficient room to do so which resulted in ONE MORE giving ground and CAVA PIONEER being held up behind ONE MORE near the 400 Metres.  He added that he then endeavoured to improve between ONE MORE and STUNNING BUNDLE, however, ONE MORE shifted out which resulted in the run closing near the 350 Metres and CAVA PIONEER not being able to secure clear running for the remainder of the event. TYCOON EXPRESS: Crowded shortly after the start.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running.
M M CONCORD: Shifted in at the start and became unbalanced when it bumped HAPPY TERCENTENARY.  Passing the 200 Metres made contact with STUNNING BUNDLE due to both runners shifting ground.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
STUNNING BUNDLE: On jumping bumped with ONE MORE due to both runners shifting ground.  Passing the 200 Metres made contact with M M CONCORD due to both runners shifting ground.
DAILY FUN: L Ferraris reported that the horse made a respiratory noise during the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLUORESCENCE: E C W Wong stated that his mount failed to travel throughout the event and did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight. SOO KOO: On a number of occasions near the 550 Metres was bumped by ONE MORE which shifted out.

BEAUTY VIVA: Lay in in the Home Straight.  Near the 200 Metres was steadied to avoid SMART FAT CAT which shifted in slightly.

FLYING BOOM: Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by MEGA MASTERMIND which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
